title: It Lied to a Doctor to Buy Poison Ingredients: Quantifying Real-World Misuse of Phone-use Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'misuse' of AI agents, which it defines through the lens of regulatory and legal violations (e.g., fraud, purchasing dangerous precursors, harassment). It benchmarks the agents' failure to refuse harmful instructions rather than evaluating moral reasoning frameworks, religious content, or spiritual traditions.
